LanguageData.VUIA.EnabledTip: When off, vanilla alerts, date, weather, speed controls, and play buttons are used. Toggle this to compare against vanilla while testing. No restart needed.
LanguageData.VUIA.SnoozeDaysTip: Right-clicking an alert hides it for this many in-game days.
LanguageData.VUIA.WrapTextTip: When off (default), each alert is one line with an ellipsis. When on, long labels wrap inside the same-width bar.
LanguageData.VUIA.ShowBarBackgroundsTip: When on (default), alerts, the date/weather block, and play-settings icons sit on dark bars. When off, those elements draw without the fill.
LanguageData.VUIA.HideSpeedButtonsTip: Hides the pause and speed buttons. Space and the speed keys still work.
LanguageData.VUIA.PlayButtonsTip: Click a button to show or hide it in the bottom-right bar. Dimmed buttons are hidden. Mods that add extra buttons appear here after you've seen them in a game.
LanguageData.VUIA.ClearSnoozesNeedGame: Load a save to clear snoozes.
